pricingStatus: Indicative fees. Final fees are fixed in your proposal after a scope review.

services.name: Delivery Exception Resolution
services.short: Turn a failed attempt into an owned next action.
services.scope: One store, one logistics connector and three agreed NDR reasons. Customer-response routing, carrier acknowledgement tracking and an owner queue.
services.recurring: Optional monitoring and improvement; human calling labour separately scoped.
services.excludes: Courier delivery is not guaranteed. Messaging, courier/API charges and calling labour are additional.
services.deliverable: Connected response journey, exception queue, carrier handoff record and mature-outcome report.

services.name: Checkout Conversation Recovery
services.short: Answer the question behind an abandoned checkout.
services.scope: One store, one channel, one defined checkout journey and three objection categories, with purchase suppression and measurement.
services.recurring: Optional named tuning and review work.
services.excludes: Platform and message usage are additional. Discounts and commercial claims require your approval.
services.deliverable: Approved answer journey, human handoff, purchase stop rules and measurement plan.

services.name: Support Resolution Assistant
services.short: Give support the right context and a safe handoff.
services.scope: One store, one helpdesk or channel and three approved intents, with identity checks and transfer to a human.
services.recurring: Optional quality review, content upkeep and agreed incident ownership.
services.excludes: Helpdesk, platform and usage fees are additional. Refund or cancellation authority is agreed explicitly.
services.deliverable: Approved intent library, verified lookup flow, escalation rules and quality checklist.

services.name: Operational Contribution Reporting
services.short: Understand what remains after the order is settled.
services.scope: Up to four agreed sources, one reconciled order model, one decision view, daily refresh and documented metric definitions.
services.recurring: Optional reconciliation and action review; dashboard access alone is not a retainer.
services.excludes: Source cleanup beyond scope, software and paid data access are additional. Booked sales are not bank cash.
services.deliverable: Reconciled contribution view, discrepancy queue, definitions and refresh runbook.

services.name: Creative Launch Sprint
services.short: One offer. A coherent creative test. Ready to launch.
services.scope: One offer brief, one direction and three message hypotheses; three short supplied-footage edits, six statics, hooks and copy, two consolidated revision rounds, launch sheet and rights register.
services.recurring: One-time sprint. Each new batch is a new scope.
services.excludes: Filming, actors, media buying and guaranteed ROAS are excluded. You supply usable, licensed assets.
services.deliverable: Nine final assets, accompanying copy, test sheet and asset register. Delivery window: 10–15 working days after approved inputs, confirmed in your proposal.

services.name: One-channel Ads Management
services.short: A defined campaign and testing workload, actively managed.
services.scope: One ad account and one channel, with campaign and creative-testing responsibilities agreed in advance.
services.recurring: Ongoing management service. Onboarding is quoted if needed.
services.excludes: Ad spend is additional. New creative production, extra channels and onboarding are separately scoped.
services.deliverable: Agreed campaign setup, testing workload and reporting responsibilities.

services.name: Product / Offer Landing Page
services.short: Give one offer a clear route to conversion.
services.scope: One page using supplied product assets, agreed analytics and one conversion path.
services.recurring: Maintenance and experimentation only if specified.
services.excludes: Hosting, paid tools, extra pages and additional content production are separately scoped.
services.deliverable: One responsive offer page, agreed tracking and a tested conversion path.

services.name: Retention Journey
services.short: A relevant next conversation with the right customer cohort.
services.scope: One defined replenishment or lapsed-customer cohort, one channel, exclusions and holdout measurement.
services.excludes: Platform, messaging, discounts and additional cohorts are extra unless included in the proposal.
services.deliverable: Cohort definition, exclusion rules, approved journey and holdout measurement plan.

services.name: Loyalty Programme
services.short: Make rewards useful, explainable and reversible.
services.scope: One rewards model in an existing selected platform, with accrual, redemption, refund reversal and reporting rules.
services.excludes: Platform fees, reward funding and ongoing programme operation are additional.
services.deliverable: Configured rewards model, tested refund reversals and programme reporting.

services.name: One-process Integration
services.short: Connect two systems around one complete business process.
services.scope: One business process across two systems, including an error queue, reconciliation and owner handoff.
services.recurring: Optional monitoring quoted for agreed coverage and incident load.
services.excludes: Paid APIs, unusual migrations and additional processes are separately scoped.
services.deliverable: Working integration, error and reconciliation checks, and an owner runbook.

services.name: One-purpose Voice Agent
services.short: One calling use case, with a clear route to a person.
services.scope: One use case, one language, one telephony provider, one business-system action and a human handoff.
services.recurring: Optional managed operation; usage is additional.
services.excludes: Telephony, model and call usage are extra. Additional languages and use cases require a new scope.
services.deliverable: Approved call flow, bounded system action, transfer rules and operating runbook.

services.name: Feedback-to-Resolution
services.short: Turn customer feedback into an accountable follow-through.
services.scope: One post-resolution feedback flow, issue routing, owner deadlines and a theme report.
services.recurring: Optional review and triage operation is separately quoted.
services.excludes: Survey, platform and messaging costs are additional. Ongoing triage requires explicit coverage.
services.deliverable: Feedback journey, issue queue, named deadlines and recurring-theme report.

discovery.name: Pre-dispatch COD confirmation
discovery.description: Evaluate confirmation and intervention rules using your existing first-party signals, including the risk of rejecting genuine buyers. Scope and fee follow a data review.

discovery.name: Refund and COD settlement visibility
discovery.description: Explore refund references, payment states and settlement exceptions across your existing tools. A bounded reporting or integration scope is quoted after discovery.

discovery.name: Freight, returns and marketplace exceptions
discovery.description: Review evidence capture, return closure or reconciliation where a specific gap remains. These are discovery-led extensions, with feasibility and price agreed individually.
